detection.direct: name or featureDefinitionId matches an Outcome token or a GATE22 taxonomy primitive
detection.lagged: a lag is declared over an input whose provenance carries Outcome ancestry or an Outcome origin type
detection.renamed: the derivedFrom chain carries an Outcome recordType or a GATE22 producer at any depth up to 16
detection.same-type laundering: recordType is Observation while provenance.originRecordType is an Outcome type

futureProvenanceRule: an input is admissible only if provenance.availableAt <= K(T); a missing availableAt or a missing K(T) is fail-closed
futureWindowRule: no session after T may appear in a window, and the window must be anchored at T

consumptionBoundaryReuse.usage: the GATE22 GATE23-row decision is reused verbatim and the GATE23 detector is applied on top of it

notAThirdClaim: no third T-CAUSAL claim is introduced by this contract
TRUSTED_CANONICAL_PRODUCER_V1 is preserved, not restated as a claim
